description_en: Deletes IP entries from an access control list (ACL)
description_zh: 调用RemoveEntriesFromAcl接口删除访问控制策略组中的IP条目
kebab_example: aliyun ga remove-entries-from-acl --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --acl-id nacl-hp34s2h0xx1ht4nwo0000 --acl-entries Entry=10.0.XX.XX/24 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveEntriesFromAcl

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the GA instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en:
The entry (IP address or CIDR block) that you want to delete. You can delete up to 50 entries at a time.

This parameter is required
fields.help_zh:
访问控制策略组条目，即IP地址条目或IP地址段条目。
一次最多支持删除50条。

该参数必填
fields.name: entry

parameters.help_en: The entries that you want to delete. You can delete up to 50 entries at a time
parameters.help_zh: 待删除的访问控制策略组条目，一次最多支持删除50条
parameters.name: acl_entries

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false(default): performs a dry run and performs the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会删除资源。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run
